IDENTITY: Codrag is a desktop AI coding assistant with an MCP server architecture, featuring a React/TypeScript UI dashboard, VSCode extension, code indexing engine, and integrated LLM tooling.

STACK: TypeScript, React, Python, Node.js. File distribution: .md 783, .tsx 372, .ts 369, .py 290, .js 272, .json 119, .css 45, .html 27. Graph: 8873 nodes, 11266 edges (contains 5827, imports 5066, calls 232, configures 101, implements 18). 52 import cycles. Entry points: packages/ui/src/components/marketing/heroes/index.ts, src/codrag/__main__.py, docs/Phase13_Storybook/theme-examples/tremor-preview/src/components/index.ts, packages/ui/src/components/viz/index.ts, packages/ui/src/components/team/index.ts.

WORKSPACE MAP: Project Root (_root, 1266 files): CLI, MCP server, code-indexing engine, configuration, LLM integration. Ui (packages/ui, 825 files): dashboard, layout management, component orchestration. Marketing (websites/apps/marketing, 66 files): marketing site. Docs (websites/apps/docs, 54 files): documentation site. Dashboard (src/codrag/dashboard, 46 files): desktop app with API integration, auto-updater. Support (websites/apps/support, 29 files): support site. Vscode (packages/vscode, 20 files): VSCode extension. Payments (websites/apps/payments, 17 files): payments site. Webview Ui (packages/vscode/webview-ui, 14 files): VSCode webview UI. Paperclip Plugin Codrag (packages/paperclip-plugin-codrag, 12 files): Paperclip plugin.

CROSS-CUTTING: Shared domains: configuration, dashboard. Hub dependencies: ext:typing (232 edges), ext:__future__ (229 edges), ext:react (198 edges), ext:logging (160 edges), ext:lucide-react (144 edges). Directory dependencies: docs references sym:codragFeatures, sym:TraceNode, sym:TraceGraphProps; engine references sym:load_policy, sym:test_code_chunk_overlap, sym:test_analyze_basic; packages references sym:RoleProjectionError, sym:SearchPanel, sym:Bare; public references sym:trigger_sync, sym:main, sym:handler; scripts references sym:log_success, sym:log_error, sym:existing_columns; src references sym:ManifestStore.is_stub_manifest, sym:MCPServer.tool_trace_neighbors, sym:list_snapshots. Longest chains: Python entry through server.py -> mcp_direct.py -> agent_gate.py -> mcp_tools.py; UI entry through heroes/index.ts -> split.tsx -> studio.tsx; docs entry through tremor-preview components.
